title: Mattresses: Good Housekeeping Tested Picks
desc: Eight Good Housekeeping Textiles Lab recommendations selected from testing and owner feedback. Items are category winners, not a direct cross-category performance ranking.

source.name: Good Housekeeping Institute — Best Mattresses of 2026
source.note: All listed products, source labels and selection context were checked against the linked source by AllRanks on 2026-10-21. The source presents distinct use-case awards, not a like-for-like composite score; the displayed order follows its numbered article sections.

items.name: Saatva Classic Mattress
items.detail: Best overall; strong comfort/support feedback and free in-home setup.

items.name: Sealy Posturepedic Spring Mattress
items.detail: Best under $1,000; pressure relief and value.

items.name: Tempur-Pedic TEMPUR-Cloud
items.detail: Best memory foam; pressure relief and motion isolation.

items.name: Stearns & Foster Estate Mattress
items.detail: Best firm; supportive coil system and strong edge support.
